profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Etsy

positions.title: Concert Office Assistant
positions.description: I organized materials for music department events, and designed and copy edited programs and posters. I managed publicity and ran the box office and backstage during concerts at the College.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: Peer tutors are chosen by professors in the respective department. I assisted students in Intro Computer Science courses as well as Music Theory courses.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I worked with the Innovations Squad on the development of the Ultimate Wedding Planner. I helped to create the front and back end of a wedding style quiz that produces vendor suggestions and planning help to drive local sales. 
I also improved the machine learning spam detector for wedding websites by implementing the Naive Bayes algorithm and enhancing feature detection. I modified the algorithm to update weekly, refreshing the training set and allowing the program to continue learning. 
We worked with Ruby on Rails, Python, SQL (postgreSQL), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

positions.title: Community Intern
positions.description: I worked with the Community Team to troubleshoot and answer user support cases for issues with the Vimeo video player using Zendesk, focusing on the Video escalations and technical questions. I also analyzed and documented pain points and feature requests in a Google Sheet for the team's reference, to help the company understand what parts of the site needed the most improvement. I also researched creator personas and categorized Vimeo's user base to provide a better understanding of the user demographic.

positions.title: Talent Intern
positions.description: I assisted the Talent Department with organizational and administrative projects, planned and organized events for the company, and  helped with record keeping, benefits, employee services and communications.
